agent.finish_summary:
Fixed the sqlparse reindent regression. Root cause: in sqlparse/filters/reindent.py, ReindentFilter._process_default had an inverted ternary 'None if stmts else self._split_statements(tlist)', which disabled statement-splitting newline insertion for normal top-level statements and incorrectly enabled it inside subquery parentheses (producing spurious extra newlines right after '('). Changed it to 'self._split_statements(tlist) if stmts else None'. Verified via direct reproduction that: two-statement reindent produces the expected 'select *
from foo;

select *
from bar;' pattern matching the reported assertion; parenthesized subquery reindent ('select * from (select * from foo) x') no longer has spurious extra newlines and matches the expected '(select *
   from foo) x' style; single-statement and keyword/AND-OR reindent (where/and/or) still work correctly; the documented intro.rst nested-subquery formatting example also now renders correctly. This should restore the previously-passing 'format reindent: keywords', 'format reindent: parenthesis', 'issue40', and related reindent-based checks without affecting any currently-working behavior.
